caption:
Tomato Soup	
soup recipe | easy | one pot 

Nutrition: 
C: 31 | F: 5 | P: 7
Calories: 189 per serving 
Makes 2 cups

Ingredients
1 tsp oil
7 cloves garlic
1 onion, sliced
4 tomatoes, quartered ( around 1/2 kg tomatoes )
a handful bunch of coriander
1 - 2 green chillies, depending on your spice level 
350-500 ml water 
1 tsp red chilli powder
1 tsp salt
1 tsp black pepper 
1 tbsp cream, optional 
brown bread croutons 
sprinkle of parmesan, to top 

Method
in a pressure cooker, add oil + garlic + onions, cook till onions are translucent 
then add in the tomatoes, chilli and coriander and saute
add in water and pressure cook for 2 whistles
allow the pressure cooker to release and then blend the mix up once cool
add it back to the pan then add in the red chilli powder, salt, pepper and cream and bring to a boil 
add to a cup and top with parmesan cheese and brown bread croutons and serve it hot :)
